limitation: The entire result is based on a modeled reference curve and expected counts
scientific_consequence: No empirical device site orbit or mission inference
required_remediation: Acquire evidence only if the project later leaves theoretical scope

limitation: V0.16 reuses the frozen V0.6 finite-key algebra and controlled loss curve
scientific_consequence: A shared model or assumption error is not detected by reproduction
required_remediation: Obtain an external independent proof and implementation review

limitation: Calculations use IEEE-754 binary64 through NumPy and SciPy
scientific_consequence: Alternate-precision and interval-arithmetic sensitivity are untested
required_remediation: Repeat critical boundaries with controlled higher precision

limitation: Only integer half-window is re-optimized while protocol probabilities and intensities remain frozen except for stated one-variable stresses
scientific_consequence: The result is not a global protocol optimum
required_remediation: Perform constrained joint optimization only after a proof profile is selected

limitation: Response ranks use non-comparable declared steps of 0.1 dB or 1 percent relative
scientific_consequence: Rank is not a global or physical Sobol importance order
required_remediation: Use normalized proof-compatible uncertainty distributions if later justified

limitation: One-parameter crossings freeze all other variables
scientific_consequence: They are not device thresholds tolerances or coupled feasibility boundaries
required_remediation: Use joint bounded optimization with evidence-backed feasible sets

limitation: The 41 by 41 grid is uniform over V0.7 research ranges and is not sampled from calibrated distributions
scientific_consequence: Positive fraction is not reliability availability or probability
required_remediation: Fit distributions only from evidence and validate them

limitation: Full phase randomization and pulse-independence conditions are not established
required_remediation: Select a generalized proof or certify the required source properties

limitation: State-preparation flaws leakage and correlations are not parameterized
scientific_consequence: Aggregate QBER cannot close these proof obligations
required_remediation: Select source-flaw and correlation-aware proof maps

limitation: Efficiency is relative and afterpulse/background are scalar IID approximations
scientific_consequence: Dead time recovery jitter saturation and detector history are absent

limitation: Efficiency mismatch over channel time wavelength and polarization is absent
scientific_consequence: The receiver measurement model is incomplete
required_remediation: Select and bound a mismatch-aware model

limitation: No device-parameter confidence region or certification failure probability is composed into a security budget
required_remediation: Define simultaneous coverage and compositional accounting

limitation: Atmosphere turbulence pointing and background are not dynamically decomposed
scientific_consequence: The aggregate curve cannot predict Tabuk availability or outages
required_remediation: Retain NOT-RUN until a future evidence-backed case is frozen

limitation: Authentication privacy-amplification implementation endpoint security and KMS are not executed
required_remediation: Implement and test separately if physical scope is later authorized

limitation: No external technical review or publication approval is present
required_remediation: Obtain named review and release authorization before publication
